name: Project website inventory and restored-surface gate
objective: Keep the live-project count, currentness, implementation credit, direct-link behavior, and restored-site close readings accurate without turning reachability into authorship or current-service claims.
hardGates: The dated inventory contains exactly 10 reachable project sites, 8 direct Jamie implementation relationships, 2 bounded or open attribution relationships, and 1 separately counted portfolio.
KC Town Hall is restored historical project evidence, not a current Tired of Tires schedule or proof of individual authorship for every page.
WOW List is a noindex tester threshold and shared co-build, not the restored calendar or a sole-authorship claim.
CallNYC is visibly archived, unofficial, and non-current; historical contacts are not resident guidance.
The three restored projects have dated close readings with product, technical, accessibility, currentness, and credit observations.
Useful project names link to their public sites in the portfolio data and every maintained Markdown resume without removing internal case-study context.
NTER CHNG remains archive-only after DNS failure and jamieburk.art remains outside the project-site count.
hillClimbRule: Improve the lowest failing gate with one bounded change, rerun the evaluator and mutation tests, and retain the change only if truth, currentness, collective credit, accessibility, and public-safety boundaries remain intact.
